# Action: 按下W键 (单点)
import ctypes
import time

# 扫描码: W = 0x11
KEY_W = 0x11
MAPVK_VK_TO_VSC = 0

# keybd_event 参数
KEYEVENTF_SCANCODE = 0x0008
KEYEVENTF_KEYUP = 0x0002

user32 = ctypes.windll.user32

# 按下
user32.keybd_event(0x57, KEY_W, KEYEVENTF_SCANCODE, 0)
time.sleep(0.05)
# 释放
user32.keybd_event(0x57, KEY_W, KEYEVENTF_SCANCODE | KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0)

result = {"action": "press_w", "status": "done"}
print("按下W键 (单点)")

# Action: 长按W键 (2秒)
import ctypes
import time

KEY_W = 0x11
KEYEVENTF_SCANCODE = 0x0008
KEYEVENTF_KEYUP = 0x0002

user32 = ctypes.windll.user32

# 按下
user32.keybd_event(0x57, KEY_W, KEYEVENTF_SCANCODE, 0)
time.sleep(2.0)
# 释放
user32.keybd_event(0x57, KEY_W, KEYEVENTF_SCANCODE | KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0)

result = {"action": "hold_w", "status": "done", "duration": 2.0}
print("长按W键 (2秒)")
